text:
maria: Heads up — opened PR to refactor the networking TF modules so provider blocks are hoisted to root and modules accept a providers_map input. Goal: remove duplicated provider blocks across services and make provider pinning centralized. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/482

sam: Will this break existing workspaces? any automatic migration or shims?

maria: We added a compatibility shim — modules still accept the old provider block if passed, but the recommended pattern is to pass providers_map = { aws = module.root_provider.aws } from root. The PR includes a small `migration.md` and a note about provider aliases.

liam: FYI hoisting can change .terraform.lock.hcl because provider selection can differ when resolved from root. Recommend running `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` in staging and committing the lockfile in a separate PR.

anya: Quick question about secrets wiring — the k8s module used to mount a specific secret path for service accounts. Do we need to rename secrets in clusters?

maria: No renames. We added a `secret_map` input so you can keep your current secret names but map keys to the module's expected keys. Example config in PR:

```hcl
module "k8s" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.internal/redwood/modules/k8s.git//core"
  providers_map = { aws = aws.root }
  secret_map = {
    token = "teams/platform/k8s-token"
    kubeconfig = "teams/platform/kubeconfig"
  }
}
```

jen: I'll take the review tomorrow morning. Can we split lockfile regen out so reviewers can focus on the API change first?

maria: Yes — plan is two PRs: (A) module refactor + migration docs + tests, (B) lockfile regen committed after smoke runs in staging.

devops-bot: CI triggered for PR #482 — terraform fmt, validate, and unit tests queued. (build 3742)

liam: I'll run a staging plan after CI passes: `make tfplan ENV=staging TARGET=networking` and post the plan snippet here. If the plan looks safe, we can apply to staging canary namespace.

sam: If lockfile PR is separate, we should coordinate applying the lockfile commit across the infra repos that share provider versions. Otherwise we'll get churn.

maria: Good call. I'll list impacted repos in the PR description and tag owners. Also adding a rollback note: if provider resolution causes issues we'll revert the lockfile commit and put back module-level provider blocks as a last resort.

jen: Also add a small checklist for oncall: smoke tests to run (ingress, basic deploy, DB connectivity) and a watch window.

maria: Added the checklist to the PR and the migration.md. Plan: review + CI today, apply to staging canary tomorrow 09:30 PDT, watch for 1 hour, then promote if green.

sam: sounds good :thumbsup:

devops-bot: build 3742 passed — validate OK, unit tests OK.

liam: Planning to post the plan output in ~20m.

maria: thanks all — ping me if you see anything funky in the plan.
